paraphrase: The 'natures' (lineages of the path) are six: the nature of habituation, the nature of innate disposition, the nature of the path, the sagely nature, the nature of equal awakening and the nature of wondrous awakening — also called the six firmnesses (firm faith, dharma, practice, virtue, summit, awakening) and the six patiences.

original.text: 佛子！性者，所謂習種性、性種性、道種性、聖種性、等覺性、妙覺性。

paraphrase: Practising the ten faiths for one, two, up to ten kalpas, one enters the ten abodes; from the first to the sixth abode, if the sixth perfection's right contemplation appears and one is protected by buddhas, bodhisattvas and good friends, one goes on (to the stage of non-retrogression).
